raw_segments.text: Mr. Bloom walked behind the eyeless feet, a flat-cut suit of herringbone tweed.
Poor young fellow, how on earth did he know that Van was there? Must have felt it. See
things in their forehead perhaps, kind of sense of volume, weight or size of it something
blacker than the dark. Wonder would he feel it if something was removed? Feel a gap. Queer
idea of Dublin he must have, tapping his way round by the stones. Could he walk in a beeline
Bloodless pious face like a fellow, going in to be a priest.
